entities.summary: Le Trianon is a theatre and concert hall in Paris. It is located at 80, boulevard de Rochechouart, in the 18th arrondissement of Paris, at the foot of the hill of Montmartre. Le Trianon is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1894. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
